title: Anne Graham Lotz
fact: A headless WordPress ministry site with an Astro front end on Cloudflare Workers, bringing daily devotions, studies and the podcast into one place.

title: Azul
fact: Kept a large Java company’s platform and documentation site healthy and moving for six years.

story.brief: A large Java company needed its platform and documentation site kept healthy and moving, year after year.
story.did: Looked after both for six years, shipping new work and keeping the docs in step with the product.
story.result: It became my longest client partnership, six years and counting.

title: Puck News
fact: Ongoing development on a live subscription news platform and its integrations, without ever breaking publishing.

title: Air Mail
fact: Rebuilt a legacy WordPress system as a Laravel app, reading the old database over an SSH tunnel through the switch so nothing was lost.

story.brief: Air Mail had outgrown a legacy WordPress system and needed to move without losing any of its content.
story.did: Built the replacement as a Laravel app that read the old database live over an SSH tunnel, so both systems ran side by side through the switch.
story.result: The move happened with nothing lost, and the team publishes on the new app today.

title: Esses Magazine
fact: A headless magazine, with an Astro front end on Cloudflare Workers against Craft CMS.

title: Perry Weather
fact: A marketing site that doubles as a product surface, with Rive animation, Preact islands and a Hono API on Cloudflare Workers.

story.brief: Perry Weather wanted a marketing site that also works as a product surface, not just a brochure.
story.did: Built it with Rive animation and Preact islands for the interactive parts, backed by a Hono API on Cloudflare Workers.
story.result: A fast, mostly static site where the interactive pieces load only where they are needed.

title: Kioti
